question: As of 10 April 2022, who among the following is the Comptroller and Auditor General of India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Girish Chandra Murmu**__. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Girish Chandra Murmu** is the **Comptroller and Auditor General of India as of 10 April 2022**.
 
• He was appointed as the **14th Comptroller and Auditor General of India on 8 August 2020**. 
 
• He is also the chairman of the **United Nations Panel of External Auditors and the Asian Organization of Supreme Audit Institutions**.
 
• He also served as the first **1st Lieutenant Governor of Jammu and Kashmir.​**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• The **Comptroller and Auditor General **of India is the **Apex Authority for External and Internal Audits of National and State Government Expenses**.
 
• It was established in **1971 under article 148 **of the Indian constitution.
 
• **V. Narhari Rao **was the **first CAG of India**.
 
• Comptroller and Auditor General of India is also known as the **Guardian of Public Purse**.
